purpose: Unapproved held-out ETTh1 extension for the current-source AutoCon linear blend and same-source strong baselines.
research_question: Does the validation-passing AutoCon Mamba/persistence blend remain non-inferior to exact v3, RLinear and PatchTST on untouched ETTh1 H96 test windows?
evidence_boundary: Unapproved draft. No job may be launched until a human approval sidecar binds this exact plan SHA-256. Validation results do not select test hyperparameters.
claim_boundary: If approved and passed, the result supports only ETTh1 H96 comparisons; it cannot establish universal accuracy, causal AutoCon attribution, or speed superiority.

required_before_launch: verify ETTh1 fingerprint and exact 32-job expansion
confirm blend bias=-4 and comparator set are frozen from validation
approve the exact plan SHA-256 in a separate launch sidecar
run all phases from one immutable source snapshot and read test metrics only after strict validation

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The blend architecture, bias, AutoCon lambda and comparator set were frozen before this draft; no test result may select a model or hyperparameter.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only the blend candidate enables the AutoCon-representation-gated linear expert; exact v3, RLinear and PatchTST remain plain comparators.
capacity_fairness_contract.test_read_gate: Read test metrics only after every registered phase validator succeeds.

phases.name: selection_current_source_validation
phases.purpose: Reproducibility check using the already registered validation contract; test split remains disabled.

phases.name: confirmatory_blend_test
phases.purpose: Frozen AutoCon Mamba/persistence blend held-out ETTh1 H96 test phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_exact_v3_test
phases.purpose: Frozen exact MambaTSv3AutoCon control without the linear blend.

phases.name: confirmatory_strong_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Frozen same-source RLinear and PatchTST held-out ETTh1 H96 comparators.

statistical_gate.interpretation: Report paired mean, seed wins and one-sided upper ratio; five seeds are the uncertainty unit and forecast windows are not independent replicates.
